competition.title: HerHack
competition.details:
HERHACK 2026 — National Level Women-Focused Hackathon:

  • HERHACK 2026 is a 36-hour national-level hackathon organized at Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad, bringing together student innovators and developers to build impactful technology solutions for real-world problems.
  • The hackathon provides participants with an opportunity to ideate, build, collaborate, and present innovative solutions across four technology tracks.

Event Details:

  • Date: 20–21 November 2026
  • ⏱ Duration: 36 Hours
  • Venue: Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad, Haryana
  • Registration Fee: FREE
  • Team Size: 2–5 members
  • Age Eligibility: 18 years and above

Tracks:

  • Participants can build their solution under one of the following four official tracks:

1. WEB3 / BLOCKCHAIN:

  • Build decentralized and trust-driven solutions using blockchain, smart contracts, Web3 infrastructure, decentralized identity, digital assets, and related technologies.

2. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI):

  • Build intelligent solutions using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Computer Vision, NLP, AI Agents, predictive systems, and related technologies.

3. INTERNET OF THINGS (IoT):

  • Build connected hardware and software solutions involving sensors, embedded systems, automation, edge computing, smart environments, and IoT platforms.

4. STUDENT INNOVATION:

  • Build innovative technology solutions addressing meaningful real-world problems. This is a broad track for ideas that do not naturally fit into the other three technical tracks.

Special Winner — Women Safety:

  • In addition to the four main tracks, HERHACK 2026 will recognize ONE Special Winner for the strongest solution focused on Women Safety.
  • Special Winner — Women Safety
  • Prize: ₹20,000
  • Women Safety is NOT a separate fifth track.
  • A Women Safety project must still belong to one of the four official tracks and can additionally compete for the Women Safety Special Winner award.

Prizes:

  • Each of the four official tracks will have three winners:
  • 1st Place — ₹20,000
  • 2nd Place — ₹15,000
  • 3rd Place — ₹10,000
  • With four tracks, the total track-wise prize distribution is ₹1,80,000.
  • Women Safety Special Winner — ₹20,000
  • TOTAL PRIZE POOL — ₹2,00,000

Eligibility:

  • Participants must be 18 years or older.
  • Team size must be between 2 and 5 members.
  • Participants may form teams with members from different colleges/institutions.
  • The event is open to eligible student innovators and developers.
  • Registration is free.
  • Participants must register through the official registration process.
  • Every team must submit a project developed during the hackathon as per the official rules.

Hackathon Format:

  • HERHACK 2026 follows a build-and-present hackathon format.
  • Participants will:
    • Register for the hackathon.
    • Form a team of 2–5 members.
    • Select a relevant track/problem statement.
    • Develop their solution during the designated hackathon period.
    • Maintain a public repository for their project.
    • Submit the required project details and deliverables.
    • Present/demo their solution to the judging panel.
    • Projects will be evaluated according to the official judging criteria.
    • Winners will be announced for each track along with the Women Safety Special Winner.

Problem Statements:

  • HERHACK 2026 features a diverse set of problem statements across the four official tracks.
  • Participants should select a problem statement or develop an eligible solution aligned with the selected track and hackathon guidelines.
  • The selected problem statement/solution must be clearly reflected in the final submission.

Project Requirements:

  • Projects must be developed within the hackathon timeline.
  • Previously built/old projects are not permitted.
  • Plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  • Teams must maintain a public GitHub repository for their project.
  • The repository must follow the prescribed HERHACK project naming format where applicable.
  • Teams must maintain a proper README explaining their project.
  • Teams must submit a project demonstration video as required.
  • A presentation deck may be required for final evaluation.
  • Maximum PPT length: 10 slides.
  • Teams must be prepared to demonstrate their working solution to the judges.

Judging:

  • Projects will be evaluated by the designated judging panel based on factors such as:
  • Innovation and originality
  • Relevance to the selected problem/track
  • Technical implementation
  • Functionality and working prototype
  • Impact and usefulness
  • Scalability and feasibility
  • Quality of presentation and demonstration
  • The final decision of the judging panel will be considered final.
  • The Women Safety Special Winner will be selected based on the strength, innovation, impact, and effectiveness of the solution specifically addressing Women Safety.

Important Rules:

  • No plagiarism or copied projects.
  • Previously developed projects are not eligible.
  • The project must be developed during the hackathon period.
  • Teams must comply with the official submission requirements.
  • Public GitHub repository is mandatory where specified.
  • Participants must follow the prescribed project naming and submission format.
  • Misrepresentation, plagiarism, or violation of hackathon rules may lead to disqualification.
  • Teams must ensure that their project does not violate applicable laws, third-party rights, or platform policies.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the rules.

Registration:

  • Registration is FREE.
  • Participants should complete the registration process and form their teams according to the prescribed guidelines.
  • For official updates, schedules, problem statements, rules, and announcements, participants should refer to the official HERHACK platform.
  • Official Website: https://herhack.netlify.app

Why Participate?:

  • Compete at a national-level hackathon.
  • Build real-world technology solutions.
  • Work with a multidisciplinary team.
  • Showcase your technical and innovative skills.
  • Get evaluated by industry/technical experts.
  • Compete for a total prize pool of ₹2,00,000.
  • Gain recognition for innovative solutions, including the Women Safety Special Award.
